name: app-overview-slide-with-inline-icon-headline-and-metadata
title: Overview Slide with Icon-Studded Headline
whatItIs: A pale grey slide with a numbered 'Overview' pill, a huge headline whose phrases alternate black and grey with blue icon bubbles, and key-value metadata at the bottom left with a paragraph at the right.
whatItMeans: Alternating tones and icon bubbles make a long headline scannable and lively.
techniques: Alternate dark and mid grey phrases in the headline
Small blue icon bubbles dotted over the text
Number bubble joined to a title pill
Paragraph right-aligned in a second column

vocabulary.definition: A small circular icon placed over or beside text.
A numbered circle joined to a label.
Label and value pairs in compact lines.
